notes: Market weapon cards now replace stale generic text such as 'Base damage 2d6 + ability modifier' with canonical FEHA weapon information.

Shop copy is generated from the live firearm, unique-weapon, and melee catalogs and shows the current doctrine/effect plus compact damage, range, attacks-per-reload, reload-point, and TO HIT DEX data where applicable.
A Market DOM observer keeps weapon descriptions synchronized after vendor rerolls, filtering, card expansion, and other Market rerenders.
The Market Stock Patch code version advances to 1.5.0 while the stock schema remains 1.4.3, so this visual/content update does not force an unnecessary vendor-stock reset.
No prices, rarity, stock composition, firearm balance, armor, cyberware, grenade, or Quickhack rules changed.
